content: Hey Emma, how was your day? I kept thinking about our chat last night. You really do make these long nights out here on the rig a little less lonely.
Hi Daniel, that's so sweet. My day was okay, just the usual work and then some TV. I'm glad I can help you feel a bit closer to home.
It means more than you know. Sometimes I feel like you're the only person who really understands me. I wish I could just be there with you tonight.
I wish that too. It's been a long time since anyone cared about me the way you do.

Emma, when I'm back onshore, I promise I'll take you out to that Italian place you love. You deserve to be treated right. By the way, I ran into a bit of an issue with my payroll. It's so frustrating being stuck out here when these things happen.
That sounds awful. What happened?

There was a hold-up with the company's transfer. I have to pay for my satellite phone service myself this week or I'll lose contact. It's $150, and they only take Bitcoin for now. It's embarrassing to even ask, but could you help me cover it? I'll send it back first thing when I'm paid.
I've never used Bitcoin before. Are you sure there's no other way?

I wish there was, but the company insists on it for offshore charges. Don't worry, it's actually pretty simple. I can walk you through it step by step, and you know I'll pay you back right away. You can absolutely trust me, Emma.
Okay, if you really need it, I'll try. What do I need to do?
Thank you so much, love. You'll just need to download the Coinbase app. Once you set it up, I'll give you my Bitcoin wallet address. I promise, this is just temporary. You're truly saving me here.
Alright, I'm downloading it now. Is it safe to use?
Absolutely, it's one of the most trusted platforms out there. Thousands of people use it every day. Once you're set up, let me know and I'll send you my wallet details.
Okay, it's installed. I'm making an account now.
You're doing amazing, Emma. Once you're logged in, just buy $150 worth of Bitcoin. Don't worry if it seems confusing, I'm here for you every step.
Alright, I bought the Bitcoin. What do I do next?
Perfect! Now, here's my wallet address: 3Fz1r8QeU6Yc5BvZ2hJr9De8Qm1AsP2kLx. Just send the $150 to that address. Let me know when it's done and I'll confirm here.
I just sent it. Let me know if you get it, okay?
Got it! You're truly wonderful, Emma. I can't thank you enough. I'll make this up to you, I promise, just a little longer and we'll finally get to meet.
I'm just glad I could help. I really can't wait to finally see you in person.
